findings: Capability/platform seeds became frontier items that NO strategy can expand (measured limitation): platform/done: 4, qualification/done: 6. The USAspending strategy ignores non-source seeds entirely.
All discovery flowed through ONE hardcoded default query (aerospace NAICS/PSC lists inside UsaspendingDiscoveryStrategy); campaign capability/platform seeds did not shape any source query.
Cross-campaign duplicate rate 1: per-campaign dedupe keys are scoped by campaignId by design, so identical recipients re-appear across campaigns and are NOT deduped globally.
Total LLM spend during the run: $0.0000 (USAspending is a free public API; no OpenRouter calls are on this path).
